summary.en: Oncology dominates Orion's clinical pipeline; partners run its pivotal prostate-cancer and cardiovascular studies. Earlier research is expanding into immuno-oncology biologics.
summary.zh: 肿瘤领域主导 Orion 的临床管线;合作伙伴开展其关键性前列腺癌和心血管研究。早期研究正在扩展至免疫肿瘤生物药。

ind.en: High-risk biochemically recurrent prostate cancer; also localized disease
ind.zh: 高危生化复发性前列腺癌;另有局限性疾病

ind.en: Metastatic castration-resistant prostate cancer; also breast, endometrial and ovarian cancers
ind.zh: 转移性去势抵抗性前列腺癌;另有乳腺癌、子宫内膜癌和卵巢癌

ind.en: Pulmonary hypertension with heart failure with preserved ejection fraction
ind.zh: 伴射血分数保留型心力衰竭的肺动脉高压

ind.en: Mesothelioma; also EHE and other solid tumours
ind.zh: 间皮瘤;另有 EHE 和其他实体瘤

watch.en: Nubeqa growth and royalties remain major earnings drivers.
watch.zh: Nubeqa 的增长和特许权使用费仍是主要盈利驱动因素。

watch.en: Bayer, MSD and Tenax conduct key late-stage trials.
watch.zh: Bayer、MSD 和 Tenax 开展关键性后期试验。

watch.en: ODM-216 is Orion's first biologic to enter clinical development.
watch.zh: ODM-216 是 Orion 首个进入临床开发的生物药。
